title: The version line's sha field is not always twelve digits: a recorded commit of 7 to 11 hex digits prints short, and a 64-digit one prints more (T4, latent)
body:
T4 (amendment A3) gives the version line as `<tool> <version> (<tree>, <sha12>[+dirty])`, but devbin's sha field is not always twelve hex digits.

`devbin_tree_line` (lib/helpers, the function ending at 3488 on main at 2951ca4e) forms the field as `${sha:0:12}${sha:40}`: the first twelve characters, then whatever follows the fortieth. That second slice is `+dirty` when the dev branch has appended it to a 40-digit HEAD. In opt and brew, though, the sha is the manifest's source_commit, and `is_commit_sha` (4147-4150) accepts seven or more hex digits. So:
- a manifest that records 7 to 11 digits prints a field shorter than twelve;
- a 64-digit commit, from a SHA-256 repository, prints its first twelve digits followed by its digits from the 41st on.

This is latent. devbin's own writers record full 40-digit shas, and devbin's repositories are SHA-1. gtools-vc found it on 2026-10-27; Gtools' writer prints unknown unless the word has twelve or more hex digits.

## Fix

Form the field from its parts: the commit's first twelve hex digits, then `+dirty` when the dev tree is dirty, never a slice past the fortieth character. A recorded commit with fewer than twelve hex digits prints `unknown`, the line's one shape for a commit it cannot name, as Gtools' writer does, or whatever the design settles under vc's review.

## Done when

1. A manifest recording a commit of 7 to 11 hex digits prints `unknown` in the field, and one recording a 64-digit commit prints exactly its first twelve digits. An arm holds each.
2. A dev tree prints twelve digits, with `+dirty` while the runtime set is dirty, as now.
3. The landing suite passes under BSD and GNU with the tree scans and help, and CI is green on the pushed head.

## Resolution

Fixed at b2cfaf632cf4c0f4ea509102a1265eaa8928994d, landed on main by vc with the rest of C (fb66b479..7565e2a2) on hv's GO of 29 Oct, as cc banked it. devbin_tree_line (lib/helpers) builds the version line's sha field from its parts.

- **From its parts:** the commit's first twelve hex digits, then `+dirty` while a dev tree's runtime set has a change git has not committed. The dev branch keeps `+dirty` in a variable of its own, where it had appended it to the sha.
- **Short commits:** a recorded commit of fewer than twelve hex digits prints `unknown`, the line's one shape for a commit it cannot name in full.
- **Long commits:** the field is never a slice past the fortieth character, so a 64-digit commit from a SHA-256 repository prints its first twelve.

No document changes: the line's shape, T4's `<sha12>[+dirty]`, is unchanged.

- **Done when 1.** localinstall.bats's arm "the version line's sha field is a recorded commit's first twelve hex digits, or unknown for one of fewer, and a dev tree's twelve take +dirty while its runtime set is dirty (0244)" installs opt from a dev source, rewrites the manifest's source_commit to each length in its table (7, 11, 12, 40 and 64 digits), and holds `--version`'s field to `unknown` for 7 and 11 and to the first twelve for the rest. It reads its table from a variable, gives each call `</dev/null` so no call can swallow a row, and counts the rows it checked against the table's own count.
- **Done when 2.** The same arm holds the dev tree: twelve digits from HEAD while its runtime set is clean, and the same twelve with `+dirty` once lib/helpers carries a change git has not committed.
- **Done when 3.** The landing suite: C's arms phase, in estate slot 01M61TNPWJTZMYNDBPTEZZ54ZG on molt-vc's grant, ran every arm tagged with one of the bank's eight issues on main 09c7d61a, file by file, from 2026-10-28 18:00Z to 18:08Z: in the red clone f4b30a50, main's lib with the bank's tests, under BSD; then at the bank's tip 53c92332 under BSD, and again with GNU coreutils, findutils, sed and grep first on PATH (~/Devel/scratch/devbin-cc/s5e/runs/arms/, summary in s5e/arms.out). 0244's arm failed in the red clone and passed under BSD and GNU. C was stopped on hv's word in its light phase, so its whole-file legs, the tree scans among them, did not finish; hv's runs on main took them over. No later fix touched its code. hv's `dvb test all` on rhadamanth at 217adf65 ran every one of the 2777 tests bats counts in tests/unit once, and none failed (tmp/test/20261029-0817.bats.out, its .errors empty). K0116B, the full suite on kovacs at 4d1a76b0 with rustup's cargo first on PATH, as on CI's Ubuntu runner, is green, as vc read its seal. CI run 40851772728 on 4d1a76b0 and CI run 40860048152 on 25175386, the head 0.1.16 was cut from, are green on Test on Ubuntu, Shell Script Analysis and Test Summary. No critic leg ran on the landed commits.

- **CI:** run 40860048152 on the pushed head 25175386, which carries the landing, read green by vc.
